verdict.rationale: Vapi assistants can autonomously execute actions during a call via tools/webhooks (transfer, lookup, book appointment) and 'assistant hooks' that automate actions on call events, showing some autonomous agentic behavior, but there is no evidence of assistants running independently in the background outside of an active call (e.g., scheduled/batch outbound campaigns, cron-triggered workflows) — automation is tied to live call events. missing for 10: evidence of background/scheduled autonomous execution not tied to an active conversation, evidence of multi-step autonomous workflows running without live call context.
